title: Files
dropHint: Drop files here to upload them.
truncated: This folder has more than {max} entries; only the first {max} are listed. Use Search to find the others.

favorite.none: Star a folder to keep it here.

selection.tooMany: Select at most {max} entries at a time.

transfer.pick: Browse to the folder the entries go into.
transfer.sameDir: The entries are already in this folder.
transfer.stepCopy: Copy {count} entry into {to} | Copy {count} entries into {to}
transfer.stepMove: Move {count} entry from {from} to {to} | Move {count} entries from {from} to {to}
transfer.stepOverwrite: Replace entries of the same name there

chmod.title: Permissions of {name}
chmod.titleMany: Permissions of {count} entry | Permissions of {count} entries
chmod.hint: The panel never sets setuid, nor setgid on files.
chmod.octalInvalid: Enter three or four octal digits, such as 644 or 2775.
chmod.setgid: Set group ID (new entries inherit the group)
chmod.sticky: Sticky (only owners may delete their entries)
chmod.recursive: Also apply to everything inside the folders
chmod.recursiveHint: Folders inside get the folder permissions, files inside the file permissions.
chmod.stepDirs: Set folders to {mode} in {count} entry and everything inside it | Set folders to {mode} in {count} entries and everything inside them

chown.title: Owner of {name}
chown.titleMany: Owner of {count} entry | Owner of {count} entries
chown.intro: Leave a field empty to keep the current owner or group.
chown.recursive: Also apply to everything inside the folders
chown.step: Give {count} entry and everything inside it to {owner} | Give {count} entries and everything inside them to {owner}

compress.title: Compress {count} entry | Compress {count} entries
compress.step: Pack {count} entry into {path} | Pack {count} entries into {path}

extract.title: Extract {name}
extract.pick: Browse to the folder the archive is extracted into.
extract.toolMissing: Extracting 7z and rar archives needs the unar tool, which is not installed.
extract.installTool: Install it on the Software page
extract.stepOverwrite: Replace files that already exist there
extract.stepKeep: Leave files that already exist there as they are
extract.stepSkip: Skip entries that cannot be extracted safely; the task log lists them

fetch.title: Download from URL
fetch.intro: The server downloads the file into {dir}.
fetch.nameHint: Leave empty to use the last part of the URL.
fetch.stepOverwrite: Replace a file of the same name there

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.trashText: The entries go to the trash of this location, where you can restore them.
delete.permanentText: The entries are deleted for good. This cannot be undone; you will be asked for your password.
delete.crossDeviceTitle: {count} entry could not go to the trash | {count} entries could not go to the trash
delete.crossDeviceText: The trash is on another file system than these entries. Delete them permanently instead? This cannot be undone.

editor.tooLarge: The editor saves files of up to {size}.
editor.discardText: Your unsaved changes will be lost.

preview.failed: The image could not be shown.

search.title: Search
search.intro: Find files and folders below this folder by name, or by the text inside them.
search.contentHint: Only text files of up to 1 MiB are searched.
search.truncated: There are more matches than shown; narrow the search.

trash.title: Trash of {root}
trash.intro: Entries deleted here wait in the trash until you restore or delete them.
trash.existsTitle: {count} entry is in the way | {count} entries are in the way
trash.existsText: Something else now exists at {path}. Replace it with the entry from the trash? | Other entries now exist where these were, such as {path}. Replace them with the entries from the trash?
trash.purgeText: This cannot be undone. You will be asked for your password.
trash.emptyText: {count} entry is deleted for good. This cannot be undone; you will be asked for your password. | {count} entries are deleted for good. This cannot be undone; you will be asked for your password.

upload.title: Uploads
upload.existsTitle: {count} file already exists here. Replace it? | {count} files already exist here. Replace them?
upload.existsText: Uploading replaces {names}. | Uploading replaces {count} files, including {names}.
upload.noFolders: Folders cannot be uploaded; upload their files or a compressed archive instead.

fullDisk.label: Full-disk access
fullDisk.enableText: The file manager will reach the whole system as root: everyone allowed to manage files can then read and change any file, including system configuration and other users' data. Turn it on only while you need it.
fullDisk.locked: The server's configuration does not allow root access, so full-disk access stays off.
fullDisk.active: Full-disk access is on: changes here affect the whole system.
